svg.title: The Brain AIOS — document ingestion and taxonomy pipeline
svg.desc: Flowchart showing how raw information enters The Brain, gets classified by document type, assigned to a department, then classified within that department before being stored in memory.

sendPrompt('How does The Brain identify document type?')

sendPrompt('How does The Brain classify content within a department?')
sendPrompt('How does The Brain store classified content in pgvector?')
sendPrompt('How does the Brain query across departments and document types?')
g.text: Semantic search · filtered by dept + type
